_meta.notes: T06 uproot, reroot crawl and settlement. Uproot is caused by saturation, a storm gust or a collapse under the root plate (ADR-052); there is no desperation buff.

damage_threshold_hp.notes: Cumulative unhealed structural damage, in biomass points, that tears the root plate free.

reroot_window_s.notes: Seconds after uprooting during which a crawl can still reach soil. After it closes the plant can only starve.

reroot_soil_min_moisture.notes: Tile moisture a root must find before it can settle again, in the same units as the resource grid.

reroot_settle_seconds.notes: Continuous seconds on valid soil before the plant is rooted again.

reroot_crawl_speed_mps.notes: Base crawl speed. Multiplied by the substrate and by mutation movement.rerootSpeed (T04).

uprooted_biomass_drain_per_s.notes: Structural biomass a detached plant loses each second when it has no water to draw on. Being torn free is a slow bleed, not a countdown: a plant lying in wet ground bleeds at detached_watered_drain_multiplier of this and can live there indefinitely, like a cutting in a glass of water. A failed reroot on dry ground still starves.

detached_watered_drain_multiplier.notes: Share of the detached bleed that still applies when the ground under the plant is at or above detached_min_tile_moisture. 1 disables hydroponic survival; 0 makes a wet detached plant effectively immortal.

detached_min_tile_moisture.notes: Tile moisture at which a detached plant counts as lying in water rather than on dry ground, in the resource grid's units.

detached_photosynthesis_multiplier.notes: Photosynthesis while detached. The canopy still catches light, but without root pressure it cannot fix carbon at the rooted rate. This is the quality-of-life cost of surviving unrooted.

detached_dry_grace_s.notes: Seconds a detached plant may lie on dry ground before the bleed is at full rate. Below this it still finds enough capillary water to slow the loss.

detached_growth_enabled.notes: Whether a detached plant may grow new parts. False by default: a plant with no roots has nothing to supply a new shoot, so the only way forward is the reroot crawl.

saturation_uproot_moisture.notes: Tile moisture at which soil counts as saturated. Ordinary rain does not reach it; sustained storm rain does.

saturation_uproot_seconds.notes: Continuous saturated seconds before the root plate gives way. The counter resets when the tile drains.

saturation_check_interval_s.notes: How often each rooted plant's tile is sampled for saturation.

gust_uproot_threshold_mps.notes: Wind a plant must catch to be torn out. Effective wind scales with exposed height.

gust_height_reference_m.notes: Height at which a plant catches the configured storm gust unchanged. Shorter plants catch less, taller ones more.

collapse_uproot_radius_m.notes: A collapse this close to the root plate takes the plant with it.

uproot_lift_m.notes: How far the root plate is lifted clear of the soil when the plant comes up, so the roots are visible.

uproot_tilt_degrees.notes: Lean of the body at the moment the root plate tears free.
